Temu Owner Reports Flat Profit, Revenue as Challenges Continue

Citi analysts pointed to Temu’s shrinking user base, with Europe leading the decline as it faces tighter regulations in the bloc

By

The Chinese owner of bargain-shopping app Temu posted flat earnings as it continued to deal with subdued consumer sentiment at home and regulatory pressures abroad.

Still, the results ended a string of profit declines for PDD Holdings PDD 11.04 % increase; up pointing triangle, whose profitability has been under pressure in recent quarters it strengthens its e-commerce ecosystem. The company has also faced challenges in overseas markets amid tightened regulatory requirements and geopolitical tensions.
